prompts.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas of ORIGINAL REGULAR ENEMIES for Dungeon Titan, matching the reference's painted textured fantasy raster rendering, NOT vector, NOT bosses. EXACT3columns x2rows, canvas1536x1024 with six equal square cells. Each COLUMN is one species. Top row all three IDLE full bodies, bottom row corresponding ATTACK full bodies. Same identity and scale within each column. Three completely different silhouettes. Front three-quarter view facing left toward heroes. Rich materials, crisp silhouette, warm upper-left rim and cool shadows. Each entire sprite and weapons occupy ONLY CENTER65% of its cell, with broad completely transparent gutters; no overlapping other cells, no giant spells. Fully isolated on genuine alpha transparent background, no floor, no text, no grid lines, no labels. COLUMN1 a feral armored forest wolf ridden by a tiny green goblin with spear; COLUMN2 a dark moss-winged cave bat with amber eyes; COLUMN3 a squat bronze-shell beetle with rocky legs and tiny crystal horn.
